          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n\n        camera.position.z = 1;\n\n        onWindowResize();\n\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n        animate();\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    const uniforms = { u_color: { value: new THREE.Color(0x00FF00) } };  // 定义 uniform 变量\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n\n        camera.position.z = 1;\n\n        onWindowResize();\n\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n        animate();\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

evt.touches[0].clientX : evt.clientX);\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.y = (evt.touches ? evt.touches[0].clientY : evt.clientY);\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

// 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();  // clock.getElapsedTime(); 如果选这个会闪瞎狗眼\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

// 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_tex: { value: new THREE.TextureLoader().load(\"https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/s.cdpn.io/2666677/flame.png\") },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    }\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock, noise;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadNoiseShader() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/noise.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            noise = data;\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadUniforms() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('json/uniforms.json')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            uniforms = JSON.parse(data).uniforms;\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    THREE.ShaderChunk.simple_lambert_vertex = `\n\tvec3 vLightFront, vLightBack;\n\t#include <beginnormal_vertex>\n\t#include <defaultnormal_vertex>\n\t#include <begin_vertex>\n\t#include <project_vertex>\n\t#include <lights_lambert_vertex>`\n\n    loadNoiseShader().then(() => {\n        THREE.ShaderChunk.noise = noise;\n        loadUniforms().then(() => {\n            loadShaders().then(() => {\n                material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n                plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n                scene.add(plane);\n            }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n        }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading uniforms:', error));\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading noise shader:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "//\n// Description : Array and textureless GLSL 2D/3D/4D simplex \n//               noise functions.\n//      Author : Ian McEwan, Ashima Arts.\n//  Maintainer : stegu\n//     Lastmod : 20110822 (ijm)\n//     License : Copyright (C) 2011 Ashima Arts. All rights reserved.\n//               Distributed under the MIT License. See LICENSE file.\n//               https://github.com/ashima/webgl-noise\n//               https://github.com/stegu/webgl-noise\n// \n\nvec3 mod289(vec3 x) {\n    return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0;\n}\n\nvec4 mod289(vec4 x) {\n    return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0;\n}\n\nvec4 permute(vec4 x) {\n    return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x);\n}\n\n\t// Permutation polynomial (ring size 289 = 17*17)\nvec3 permute(vec3 x) {\n    return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x);\n}\n\nfloat permute(float x) {\n    return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0;\n    ;\n}\n\nvec4 taylorInvSqrt(vec4 r) {\n    return 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * r;\n}\n\nvec2 fade(vec2 t) {\n    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);\n}\n\nvec3 fade(vec3 t) {\n    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);\n}\n\n\t// Hashed 2-D gradients with an extra rotation.\n\t// (The constant 0.0243902439 is 1/41)\nvec2 rgrad2(vec2 p, float rot) {\n\t#if 0\n\t// Map from a line to a diamond such that a shift maps to a rotation.\n    float u = permute(permute(p.x) + p.y) * 0.0243902439 + rot; // Rotate by shift\n    u = 4.0 * fract(u) - 2.0;\n\t  // (This vector could be normalized, exactly or approximately.)\n    return vec2(abs(u) - 1.0, abs(abs(u + 1.0) - 2.0) - 1.0);\n\t#else\n\t// For more isotropic gradients, sin/cos can be used instead.\n    float u = permute(permute(p.x) + p.y) * 0.0243902439 + rot; // Rotate by shift\n    u = fract(u) * 6.28318530718; // 2*pi\n    return vec2(cos(u), sin(u));\n\t#endif\n}\n\nfloat snoise(vec3 v) {\n    const vec2 C = vec2(1.0 / 6.0, 1.0 / 3.0);\n    const vec4 D = vec4(0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0);\n\n\t// First corner\n    vec3 i = floor(v + dot(v, C.yyy));\n    vec3 x0 = v - i + dot(i, C.xxx);\n\n\t// Other corners\n    vec3 g = step(x0.yzx, x0.xyz);\n    vec3 l = 1.0 - g;\n    vec3 i1 = min(g.xyz, l.zxy);\n    vec3 i2 = max(g.xyz, l.zxy);\n\n\t  //   x0 = x0 - 0.0 + 0.0 * C.xxx;\n\t  //   x1 = x0 - i1  + 1.0 * C.xxx;\n\t  //   x2 = x0 - i2  + 2.0 * C.xxx;\n\t  //   x3 = x0 - 1.0 + 3.0 * C.xxx;\n    vec3 x1 = x0 - i1 + C.xxx;\n    vec3 x2 = x0 - i2 + C.yyy; // 2.0*C.x = 1/3 = C.y\n    vec3 x3 = x0 - D.yyy;      // -1.0+3.0*C.x = -0.5 = -D.y\n\n\t// Permutations\n    i = mod289(i);\n    vec4 p = permute(permute(permute(i.z + vec4(0.0, i1.z, i2.z, 1.0)) + i.y + vec4(0.0, i1.y, i2.y, 1.0)) + i.x + vec4(0.0, i1.x, i2.x, 1.0));\n\n\t// Gradients: 7x7 points over a square, mapped onto an octahedron.\n\t// The ring size 17*17 = 289 is close to a multiple of 49 (49*6 = 294)\n    float n_ = 0.142857142857; // 1.0/7.0\n    vec3 ns = n_ * D.wyz - D.xzx;\n\n    vec4 j = p - 49.0 * floor(p * ns.z * ns.z);  //  mod(p,7*7)\n\n    vec4 x_ = floor(j * ns.z);\n    vec4 y_ = floor(j - 7.0 * x_);    // mod(j,N)\n\n    vec4 x = x_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;\n    vec4 y = y_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;\n    vec4 h = 1.0 - abs(x) - abs(y);\n\n    vec4 b0 = vec4(x.xy, y.xy);\n    vec4 b1 = vec4(x.zw, y.zw);\n\n\t  //vec4 s0 = vec4(lessThan(b0,0.0))*2.0 - 1.0;\n\t  //vec4 s1 = vec4(lessThan(b1,0.0))*2.0 - 1.0;\n    vec4 s0 = floor(b0) * 2.0 + 1.0;\n    vec4 s1 = floor(b1) * 2.0 + 1.0;\n    vec4 sh = -step(h, vec4(0.0));\n\n    vec4 a0 = b0.xzyw + s0.xzyw * sh.xxyy;\n    vec4 a1 = b1.xzyw + s1.xzyw * sh.zzww;\n\n    vec3 p0 = vec3(a0.xy, h.x);\n    vec3 p1 = vec3(a0.zw, h.y);\n    vec3 p2 = vec3(a1.xy, h.z);\n    vec3 p3 = vec3(a1.zw, h.w);\n\n\t//Normalise gradients\n    vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(p0, p0), dot(p1, p1), dot(p2, p2), dot(p3, p3)));\n    p0 *= norm.x;\n    p1 *= norm.y;\n    p2 *= norm.z;\n    p3 *= norm.w;\n\n\t// Mix final noise value\n    vec4 m = max(0.6 - vec4(dot(x0, x0), dot(x1, x1), dot(x2, x2), dot(x3, x3)), 0.0);\n    m = m * m;\n    return 42.0 * dot(m * m, vec4(dot(p0, x0), dot(p1, x1), dot(p2, x2), dot(p3, x3)));\n}\n\n\t// Classic Perlin noise\nfloat cnoise(vec2 P) {\n    vec4 Pi = floor(P.xyxy) + vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n    vec4 Pf = fract(P.xyxy) - vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n    Pi = mod289(Pi); // To avoid truncation effects in permutation\n    vec4 ix = Pi.xzxz;\n    vec4 iy = Pi.yyww;\n    vec4 fx = Pf.xzxz;\n    vec4 fy = Pf.yyww;\n\n    vec4 i = permute(permute(ix) + iy);\n\n    vec4 gx = fract(i * (1.0 / 41.0)) * 2.0 - 1.0;\n    vec4 gy = abs(gx) - 0.5;\n    vec4 tx = floor(gx + 0.5);\n    gx = gx - tx;\n\n    vec2 g00 = vec2(gx.x, gy.x);\n    vec2 g10 = vec2(gx.y, gy.y);\n    vec2 g01 = vec2(gx.z, gy.z);\n    vec2 g11 = vec2(gx.w, gy.w);\n\n    vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(g00, g00), dot(g01, g01), dot(g10, g10), dot(g11, g11)));\n    g00 *= norm.x;\n    g01 *= norm.y;\n    g10 *= norm.z;\n    g11 *= norm.w;\n\n    float n00 = dot(g00, vec2(fx.x, fy.x));\n    float n10 = dot(g10, vec2(fx.y, fy.y));\n    float n01 = dot(g01, vec2(fx.z, fy.z));\n    float n11 = dot(g11, vec2(fx.w, fy.w));\n\n    vec2 fade_xy = fade(Pf.xy);\n    vec2 n_x = mix(vec2(n00, n01), vec2(n10, n11), fade_xy.x);\n    float n_xy = mix(n_x.x, n_x.y, fade_xy.y);\n    return 2.3 * n_xy;\n}\n\n\t// Classic Perlin noise, periodic variant\nfloat pnoise(vec2 P, vec2 rep) {\n    vec4 Pi = floor(P.xyxy) + vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n    vec4 Pf = fract(P.xyxy) - vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n    Pi = mod(Pi, rep.xyxy); // To create noise with explicit period\n    Pi = mod289(Pi);        // To avoid truncation effects in permutation\n    vec4 ix = Pi.xzxz;\n    vec4 iy = Pi.yyww;\n    vec4 fx = Pf.xzxz;\n    vec4 fy = Pf.yyww;\n\n    vec4 i = permute(permute(ix) + iy);\n\n    vec4 gx = fract(i * (1.0 / 41.0)) * 2.0 - 1.0;\n    vec4 gy = abs(gx) - 0.5;\n    vec4 tx = floor(gx + 0.5);\n    gx = gx - tx;\n\n    vec2 g00 = vec2(gx.x, gy.x);\n    vec2 g10 = vec2(gx.y, gy.y);\n    vec2 g01 = vec2(gx.z, gy.z);\n    vec2 g11 = vec2(gx.w, gy.w);\n\n    vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(g00, g00), dot(g01, g01), dot(g10, g10), dot(g11, g11)));\n    g00 *= norm.x;\n    g01 *= norm.y;\n    g10 *= norm.z;\n    g11 *= norm.w;\n\n    float n00 = dot(g00, vec2(fx.x, fy.x));\n    float n10 = dot(g10, vec2(fx.y, fy.y));\n    float n01 = dot(g01, vec2(fx.z, fy.z));\n    float n11 = dot(g11, vec2(fx.w, fy.w));\n\n    vec2 fade_xy = fade(Pf.xy);\n    vec2 n_x = mix(vec2(n00, n01), vec2(n10, n11), fade_xy.x);\n    float n_xy = mix(n_x.x, n_x.y, fade_xy.y);\n    return 2.3 * n_xy;\n}\n\t// Classic Perlin noise\nfloat cnoise(vec3 P) {\n    vec3 Pi0 = floor(P); // Integer part for indexing\n    vec3 Pi1 = Pi0 + vec3(1.0); // Integer part + 1\n    Pi0 = mod289(Pi0);\n    Pi1 = mod289(Pi1);\n    vec3 Pf0 = fract(P); // Fractional part for interpolation\n    vec3 Pf1 = Pf0 - vec3(1.0); // Fractional part - 1.0\n    vec4 ix = vec4(Pi0.x, Pi1.x, Pi0.x, Pi1.x);\n    vec4 iy = vec4(Pi0.yy, Pi1.yy);\n    vec4 iz0 = Pi0.zzzz;\n    vec4 iz1 = vec2 per, float rot) {\n\t  // Hack: offset y slightly to hide some rare artifacts\n    pos.y += 0.01;\n\t  // Skew to hexagonal grid\n    vec2 uv = vec2(pos.x + pos.y * 0.5, pos.y);\n\n    vec2 i0 = functions in the file.\n\t//\nfloat snoise(vec2 pos) {\n    return srnoise(pos, 0.0);\n}\n\nfloat hash(float x, float y) {\n    return fract(abs(sin(sin(123.321 + x) * (y + 321.123)) * 456.654));\n}\n\nfloat lerp(float a, float b, float t) {\n    return a * (1.0 - t) + b * t;\n}\n\nfloat perlin(float x, float y) {\n    float col = 0.0;\n    for(int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n        float fx = floor(x);\n        float fy = floor(y);\n        float cx = ceil(x);\n        float cy = ceil(y);\n        float a = hash(fx, fy);\n        float b = hash(fx, cy);\n        float c = hash(cx, fy);\n        float d = hash(cx, cy);\n        col += lerp(lerp(a, b, fract(y)), lerp(c, d, fract(y)), fract(x));\n        col /= 2.0;\n        x /= 2.0;\n        y /= 2.0;\n    }\n    return col;\n}\n\nfloat dperlin(float x, float y) {\n    float d = perlin(x, y) * 800.0;\n    return perlin(x + d, y + d);\n}\n\nfloat ddperlin(float x, float y) {\n    float d = perlin(x, y) * 800.0;\n    return dperlin(x + d, y + d);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock, noise;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadNoiseShader() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/noise.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            noise = data;\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadUniforms() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('json/uniforms.json').then(response => response.json())  // 解析 JSON 数据\n        .then(data => {\n            uniforms = {\n                u_tex: { value: new THREE.TextureLoader().load(data.uniforms.u_tex.value) },\n                u_time: { value: data.uniforms.u_time.value },\n                u_mouse: { value: { x: data.uniforms.u_mouse.value.x, y: data.uniforms.u_mouse.value.y } },\n                u_resolution: { value: { x: data.uniforms.u_resolution.value.x, y: data.uniforms.u_resolution.value.y } }\n            };\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    loadNoiseShader().then(() => {\n        THREE.ShaderChunk.noise = noise;\n        loadUniforms().then(() => {\n            loadShaders().then(() => {\n                material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n                plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n                scene.add(plane);\n            }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n        }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading uniforms:', error));\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading noise shader:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "//\n// Description : Array and textureless GLSL 2D/3D/4D simplex \n//               noise functions.\n//      Author : Ian McEwan, Ashima Arts.\n//  Maintainer : stegu\n//     Lastmod : 20110822 (ijm)\n//     License : Copyright (C) 2011 Ashima Arts. All rights reserved.\n//               Distributed under the MIT License. See LICENSE file.\n//               https://github.com/ashima/webgl-noise\n//               https://github.com/stegu/webgl-noise\n// \n\nvec3 mod289(vec3 x) {\n    return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0;\n}\n\nvec4 mod289(vec4 x) {\n    return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0;\n}\n\nvec4 permute(vec4 x) {\n    return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x);\n}\n\n\t// Permutation polynomial (ring size 289 = 17*17)\nvec3 permute(vec3 x) {\n    return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x);\n}\n\nfloat permute(float x) {\n    return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0;\n    ;\n}\n\nvec4 taylorInvSqrt(vec4 r) {\n    return 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * r;\n}\n\nvec2 fade(vec2 t) {\n    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);\n}\n\nvec3 fade(vec3 t) {\n    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);\n}\n\n\t// Hashed 2-D gradients with an extra rotation.\n\t// (The constant 0.0243902439 is 1/41)\nvec2 rgrad2(vec2 p, float rot) {\n\t#if 0\n\t// Map from a line to a diamond such that a shift maps to a rotation.\n    float u = permute(permute(p.x) + p.y) * 0.0243902439 + rot; // Rotate by shift\n    u = 4.0 * fract(u) - 2.0;\n\t  // (This vector could be normalized, exactly or approximately.)\n    return vec2(abs(u) - 1.0, abs(abs(u + 1.0) - 2.0) - 1.0);\n\t#else\n\t// For more isotropic gradients, sin/cos can be used instead.\n    float u = permute(permute(p.x) + p.y) * 0.0243902439 + rot; // Rotate by shift\n    u = fract(u) * 6.28318530718; // 2*pi\n    return vec2(cos(u), sin(u));\n\t#endif\n}\n\nfloat snoise(vec3 v) {\n    const vec2 C = vec2(1.0 / 6.0, 1.0 / 3.0);\n    const vec4 D = vec4(0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0);\n\n\t// First corner\n    vec3 i = floor(v + dot(v, C.yyy));\n    vec3 x0 = v - i + dot(i, C.xxx);\n\n\t// Other corners\n    vec3 g = step(x0.yzx, x0.xyz);\n    vec3 l = 1.0 - g;\n    vec3 i1 = min(g.xyz, l.zxy);\n    vec3 i2 = max(g.xyz, l.zxy);\n\n\t  //   x0 = x0 - 0.0 + 0.0 * C.xxx;\n\t  //   x1 = x0 - i1  + 1.0 * C.xxx;\n\t  //   x2 = x0 - i2  + 2.0 * C.xxx;\n\t  //   x3 = x0 - 1.0 + 3.0 * C.xxx;\n    vec3 x1 = x0 - i1 + C.xxx;\n    vec3 x2 = x0 - i2 + C.yyy; // 2.0*C.x = 1/3 = C.y\n    vec3 x3 = x0 - D.yyy;      // -1.0+3.0*C.x = -0.5 = -D.y\n\n\t// Permutations\n    i = mod289(i);\n    vec4 p = permute(permute(permute(i.z + vec4(0.0, i1.z, i2.z, 1.0)) + i.y + vec4(0.0, i1.y, i2.y, 1.0)) + i.x + vec4(0.0, i1.x, i2.x, 1.0));\n\n\t// Gradients: 7x7 points over a square, mapped onto an octahedron.\n\t// The ring size 17*17 = 289 is close to a multiple of 49 (49*6 = 294)\n    float n_ = 0.142857142857; // 1.0/7.0\n    vec3 ns = n_ * D.wyz - D.xzx;\n\n    vec4 j = p - 49.0 * floor(p * ns.z * ns.z);  //  mod(p,7*7)\n\n    vec4 x_ = floor(j * ns.z);\n    vec4 y_ = floor(j - 7.0 * x_);    // mod(j,N)\n\n    vec4 x = x_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;\n    vec4 y = y_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;\n    vec4 h = 1.0 - abs(x) - abs(y);\n\n    vec4 b0 = vec4(x.xy, y.xy);\n    vec4 b1 = vec4(x.zw, y.zw);\n\n\t  //vec4 s0 = vec4(lessThan(b0,0.0))*2.0 - 1.0;\n\t  //vec4 s1 = vec4(lessThan(b1,0.0))*2.0 - 1.0;\n    vec4 s0 = floor(b0) * 2.0 + 1.0;\n    vec4 s1 = floor(b1) * 2.0 + 1.0;\n    vec4 sh = -step(h, vec4(0.0));\n\n    vec4 a0 = b0.xzyw + s0.xzyw * sh.xxyy;\n    vec4 a1 = b1.xzyw + s1.xzyw * sh.zzww;\n\n    vec3 p0 = vec3(a0.xy, h.x);\n    vec3 p1 = vec3(a0.zw, h.y);\n    vec3 p2 = vec3(a1.xy, h.z);\n    vec3 p3 = vec3(a1.zw, h.w);\n\n\t//Normalise gradients\n    vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(p0, p0), dot(p1, p1), dot(p2, p2), dot(p3, p3)));\n    p0 *= norm.x;\n    p1 *= norm.y;\n    p2 *= norm.z;\n    p3 *= norm.w;\n\n\t// Mix final noise value\n    vec4 m = max(0.6 - vec4(dot(x0, x0), dot(x1, x1), dot(x2, x2), dot(x3, x3)), 0.0);\n    m = m * m;\n    return 42.0 * dot(m * m, vec4(dot(p0, x0), dot(p1, x1), dot(p2, x2), dot(p3, x3)));\n}\n\n\t// Classic Perlin noise\nfloat cnoise(vec2 P) {\n    vec4 Pi = floor(P.xyxy) + vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n    vec4 Pf = fract(P.xyxy) - vec4(0.0, 0.0, 2-D non-tiling simplex noise with fixed gradients and analytical derivative.\n\t// This function is implemented as a wrapper to \"srdnoise\",\n\t// at the minimal cost of three extra additions.\n\t//\nvec3 sdnoise(vec2 pos) {\n    return srdnoise(pos, 0.0);\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D non-tiling simplex noise with rotating gradients,\n\t// without the analytical derivative.\n\t//\nfloat srnoise(vec2 pos, float rot) {\n\t  // Offset y slightly to hide some rare artifacts\n    pos.y += 0.001;\n\t  // Skew to hexagonal grid\n    vec2 uv = vec2(pos.x + pos.y * 0.5, pos.y);\n\n    vec2 i0 = floor(uv);\n    vec2 f0 = fract(uv);\n\t  // Traversal order\n    vec2 i1 = (f0.x > f0.y) ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : vec2(0.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Unskewed grid points in (x,y) space\n    vec2 p0 = vec2(i0.x - i0.y * 0.5, i0.y);\n    vec2 p1 = vec2(p0.x + i1.x - i1.y * 0.5, p0.y + i1.y);\n    vec2 p2 = vec2(p0.x + 0.5, p0.y + 1.0);\n\n\t  // Integer grid point indices in (u,v) space\n    i1 = i0 + i1;\n    vec2 i2 = i0 + vec2(1.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Vectors in unskewed (x,y) coordinates from\n\t  // each of the simplex corners to the evaluation point\n    vec2 d0 = pos - p0;\n    vec2 d1 = pos - p1;\n    vec2 d2 = pos - p2;\n\n\t  // Wrap i0, i1 and i2 to the desired period before gradient hashing:\n\t  // wrap points in (x,y), map to (u,v)\n    vec3 x = vec3(p0.x, p1.x, p2.x);\n    vec3 y = vec3(p0.y, p1.y, p2.y);\n    vec3 iuw = x + 0.5 * y;\n    vec3 ivw = y;\n\n\t  // Avoid precision issues in permutation\n    iuw = mod289(iuw);\n    ivw = mod289(ivw);\n\n\t  // Create gradients from indices\n    vec2 g0 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.x, ivw.x), rot);\n    vec2 g1 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.y, ivw.y), rot);\n    vec2 g2 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.z, ivw.z), rot);\n\n\t  // Gradients dot vectors to corresponding corners\n\t  // (The derivatives of this are simply the gradients)\n    vec3 w = vec3(dot(g0, d0), dot(g1, d1), dot(g2, d2));\n\n\t  // Radial weights from corners\n\t  // 0.8 is the square of 2/sqrt(5), the distance from\n\t  // a grid point to the nearest simplex boundary\n    vec3 t = 0.8 - vec3(dot(d0, d0), dot(d1, d1), dot(d2, d2));\n\n\t  // Set influence of each surflet to zero outside radius sqrt(0.8)\n    t = max(t, 0.0);\n\n\t  // Fourth power of t\n    vec3 t2 = t * t;\n    vec3 t4 = t2 * t2;\n\n\t  // Final noise value is:\n\t  // sum of ((radial weights) times (gradient dot vector from corner))\n    float n = dot(t4, w);\n\n\t  // Rescale to cover the range [-1,1] reasonably well\n    return 11.0 * n;\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D non-tiling simplex noise with fixed gradients,\n\t// without the analytical derivative.\n\t// This function is implemented as a wrapper to \"srnoise\",\n\t// at the minimal cost of three extra additions.\n\t// Note: if this kind of noise is all you want, there are faster\n\t// GLSL implementations of non-tiling simplex noise out there.\n\t// This one is included mainly for completeness and compatibility\n\t// with the other functions in the file.\n\t//\nfloat snoise(vec2 pos) {\n    return srnoise(pos, 0.0);\n}\n\nfloat hash(float x, float y) {\n    return fract(abs(sin(sin(123.321 + x) * (y + 321.123)) * 456.654));\n}\n\nfloat lerp(float a, float b, float t) {\n    return a * (1.0 - t) + b * t;\n}\n\nfloat perlin(float x, float y) {\n    float col = 0.0;\n    for(int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n        float fx = floor(x);\n        float fy = floor(y);\n        float cx = ceil(x);\n        float cy = ceil(y);\n        float a = hash(fx, fy);\n        float b = hash(fx, cy);\n        float c = hash(cx, fy);\n        float d = hash(cx, cy);\n        col += lerp(lerp(a, b, fract(y)), lerp(c, d, fract(y)), fract(x));\n        col /= 2.0;\n        x /= 2.0;\n        y /= 2.0;\n    }\n    return col;\n}\n\nfloat dperlin(float x, float y) {\n    float d = perlin(x, y) * 800.0;\n    return perlin(x + d, y + d);\n}\n\nfloat ddperlin(float x, float y) {\n    float d = perlin(x, y) * 800.0;\n    return dperlin(x + d, y + d);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock, noise;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadUniforms() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('json/uniforms.json').then(response => response.json())\n        .then(data => {\n            uniforms = data.uniforms;\n            uniforms.u_tex.value = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(data.uniforms.u_tex.value);\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {u_time: { value: 0 }};\n\n    loadUniforms().then(() => {\n        loadShaders().then(() => {\n            material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n            plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n            scene.add(plane);\n        }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading uniforms:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 1.5);\n    uniforms = {\n        u_tex_1: { value: null },\n        u_tex_2: { value: null },\n        u_duration: { value: 2.0 },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n        u_mouse: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0, y: 0 } }\n    }\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    if ('ontouchstart' in window) {\n        document.addEventListener('touchmove', move);\n    } else {\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n        document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);\n    }\n\n\n\n    index = 0;\n    images = [];\n    loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();\n    loader.setPath('https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/s.cdpn.io/2666677/');\n    loadNextImage(loader);\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n \n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n \n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction loadNextImage(loader) {\n    index++;\n    if (index > 5) {\n        index = 0;\n        uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n        uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[1];\n        uniforms.u_time.value = 0;\n\n        const prev = document.getElementById(\"prev\");\n\n        prev.onclick = function () {\n            uniforms.u_time.value = 0;\n\n            if (index == 4) {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[4];\n            } else if (index < 0) {\n                index = 4;\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[4];\n            } else {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[index + 1];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[index];\n            }\n            const msg = document.getElementById(\"msg\");\n            msg.style.display = \"none\";\n            index--;\n        };\n\n        const next = document.getElementById(\"next\");\n\n        next.onclick = function () {\n            uniforms.u_time.value = 0;\n\n            index++;\n            if (index >= 5) {\n                index = 0;\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[1];\n            } else if (index == 4) {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[4];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[0];\n            } else {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[index];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[index + 1];\n            }\n            const msg = document.getElementById(\"msg\");\n            msg.style.display = \"none\";\n        };\n\n        animate();\n    } else {\n        loader.load(`sa${index}.jpg`, function (tex) {\n            images.push(tex);\n            loadNextImage(loader);\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n\nfunction move(evt) {\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.x = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientX : evt.clientX;\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.y = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientY : evt.clientY;\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= (2 / 1.5)) {\n        console.log(\"resize: Use width\");\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        console.log(\"resize: Use height\")\n        height = 1.5 / 2;\n        width = (window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight) * height;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    const delta = clock.getDelta();\n    if (uniforms.u_time.value < uniforms.u_duration.value) {\n        uniforms.u_time.value += delta;\n    } else {\n        uniforms.u_time.value = uniforms.u_duration.value;\n    }\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "let scene, camera, geometry, clock, renderer, controls, uniforms, ball, material, material1, vShader, fShader;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(\n        45,\n        window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,\n        1,\n        1000\n    );\n    camera.position.z = 100;\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n\n    geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(30, 30, 30, 10, 10, 10);\n\n    uniforms = {};\n    uniforms.u_time = { value: 0.0 };\n    uniforms.u_mouse = { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } };\n    uniforms.u_resolution = { value: { x: 0, y: 0 } };\n    uniforms.u_radius = { value: 20.0 };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({\n            uniforms: uniforms,\n            vertexShader: vShader,\n            fragmentShader: fShader,\n            wireframe: true\n        });\n\n        material1 = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n            color: 0xb7ff00,\n            wireframe: true\n        });\n\n        ball = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(ball);\n\n        controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);\n\n        onWindowResize();\n        if ('ontouchstart' in window) {\n            document.addEventListener('touchmove', move);\n        } else {\n            window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n            document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);\n        }\n\n        function move(evt) {\n            uniforms.u_mouse.value.x = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientX : evt.clientX;\n            uniforms.u_mouse.value.y = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientY : evt.clientY;\n        }\n\n        animate();\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",
